segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one with adult acne and oily skin at 53, report the product helps with breakouts and excess shine without weighing skin down, though one combination-skin reviewer found it made her face oilier and triggered breakouts.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some in desert or winter climates, report relief from flaking and cracked patches, though one dry-skin reviewer found the alcohol content made the product burn like alcohol on the face.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin and dryness around the mouth/nose reports the product fixed dryness but left her overall skin greasy and prone to breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin frequently report no irritation and good tolerance, sometimes with a slight tingle, though a few sensitive-skin users note it stings, causes tingling, or requires reduced frequency to avoid reaction.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s, 70s, and post-menopause report brighter, firmer, smoother-looking skin and reduced pore visibility, with one 74-year-old citing new adult breakouts resolved and another 53-year-old noting improvement in age-related oiliness and acne.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on aging report brighter, firmer, more even-toned skin and reduced fine lines and pores; some also mention brown spots or slower-onset wrinkles as a concern rather than a resolved issue.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers cite relief from dry, flaky, cracked or patchy skin, especially in winter or desert climates, with several reporting smoother, softer skin; dissent includes reports of the product burning or drying skin further due to its alcohol content.
concerns.redness: A small number of reviewers with rosacea or generally reactive skin report no flare-up or reaction using the product regularly; no reports of redness being caused, but some reviewers note tingling or sun sensitivity afterward.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer noted the product left her sensitive, dry skin without irritation over long-term Clinique use, while others report stinging, burning, or an alcohol-forward sensation suggesting barrier discomfort for some users.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report dark or brown spots and uneven tone improving with continued use; no reports of spots worsening.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers report reduced blemishes, cleared breakouts, and fewer bumps or ingrown hairs, though one reviewer states it did not cure her cystic acne and another reports new breakouts caused by increased oiliness.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers describing oily or combination skin report reduced shine and improved pore appearance, but one combination-skin reviewer reports the product made her skin oilier and led to breakouts.

extraits.titre: my face feels like a pizza
extraits.texte: I had high hopes for this product! I have combination skin with dryness around my mouth and nose which cause make up to look cakey. So I got this to help with that problem (also I hardly ever wear make up). It definitely helped with the dryness, but in turn, it has made my face SO oily. That has made it to where I break out. I feel like over all my skin looks better but I just can't shake the greasyness of the product.

I am 74 years young, and suddenly after years of normal skin, suddenly have an oily nose, upper lip, and chin. I developed white heads and couldn't find anything that wouldn't dry out my skin completely but would be effective. FYI, I do use a sonic brush every day and exfoliate with a gentle scrub a few times a week. Nothing worked - until this! In spite the instructions to use 2 to 3 times a week, I have found that my skin comfortably tolerates almost every day, even though I have a form of Rosacea. The only down side is the size of the product, and even if I only used it 2-3 times a week, it would rapidly disappear. The instructions say to apply with a cotton pad - so that also soaks up some additional product. Clinique should offer this in a much larger size for those of us who want to use it more frequently. Because of the size, and price for the size - I took off one star.

I have always taken care of my skin since my teenage years and I have been rewarded with an appearance of at least 10 years younger than my age . I live in a very dry climate and require multiple products for moisturizing. As I have aged, I developed brown spots. Although wrinkles have not been my primary concern, I wanted to begin using retinol products. I typically do not have sensitive skin but I found that I had to discontinue even after reading about ways to avoid irritation. I may try again in a month or so. My point is, I have somewhat sensitive and typically very dry skin. I have had NO problems with this product. I have used the Clinique system for years and find that at times when I omit the clarifying lotion or rush through the steps, I get small bumps on my forehead. This product leaves my skin so smooth. I do feel a slight tingling after application but after a few moments that goes away. I use moisture surge on the driest areas on top of my typical moisturizer to alleviate the sensation. Again, I have used the Clinique regime for decades so I think that some people may want to start a consistent program making sure to incorporate the clarifying lotion. You can't expect one product to change your appearance. You have to be diligent and let your skin acclimate to changes. Then, try products such as this one after reading all the directions. I will admit that this sat on my shelf for a bit until I read and understood how to apply it and when. I may use it in my T-z

A sample proved my skin care program wanted this in my weekly routine. I promptly purchased a full size. It's quite safe on my very dry, extremely sensitive skin. The results are a brighter, softer complexion. I am happily surprised with this safe product where other brands caused me redness and pain.

I am 53 and post menopause so really seeing some signs of aging. I also am still breaking out with acne and have very oily skin so normal age fighters just break me out and moisturizers won't absorb and just sit on my skin. That is why I love this product so much, it's easy, it doesn't weigh my skin down, actually helps with my break outs and if you use it religiously you will see results

Living in the desert during the winter is tough on my skin. My face is not only dry, but it's a combination of hard/cracked skin and flakiness. An Ulta gal gave me a sample of this peel and it worked so well, that I bought a bottle shortly after!
